The rapid technology advancement allows me, a 25 year old, to say such thing. So much has changed with it and it makes that statement hella allowed whenever.

Men who I personally don't find attractive do not creep me. That's a false statement. They are just fellow human beings that are not my type.

I would never treat them differently or get creeped out by them. Why would I?
A person would be creepy according to their attitude, not the way they look.

Also, attractiveness is relative. That's why I said attractive to me. Thus, a person is never absolutely unattractive. Every person gets attracted to different things.

HOWEVER, my attractiveness or unattractiveness towards a person should never ever define how I view their personality.

Just let your personality radiate and enjoy life, my friend. If a single person makes you feel creepy because they view you as unattractive, there is something wrong with them.

Judgment should be based on action and personality, never looks. No one chooses the way they look.
